footer.tagline: Where Culture Meets Capital, Intellect Meets Value.

home.heroSubtitle: Molnet Cultural Communication Limited bridges the cultural industry and capital markets — creating lasting value through insight and a global perspective.
home.introTitle: A Value Creator Rooted in Culture
home.introBody: We are an integrated advisory firm focused on the convergence of culture and capital. Our team brings together seasoned professionals in strategy consulting, investment advisory and content production to deliver end-to-end solutions.
home.pillarsSubtitle: From strategy consulting to capital advisory, from content creation to global expansion — we cover the key nodes of the cultural industry value chain.
home.pillar1Desc: Data-driven insight and clear, actionable strategies for cultural enterprises and institutions.
home.pillar2Desc: Connecting quality capital with cultural projects — financing, valuation and deal structuring advisory.
home.pillar3Desc: Producing globally competitive content that carries brands and cultural projects into new markets.
home.pillar4Desc: From brand positioning to IP incubation — building cultural assets with lasting commercial value.
home.philosophyBody: We believe true value emerges from the dialogue between culture and capital — where intellect inspires creation, and creation cultivates value. This is both our philosophy and the way we move forward with every partner.
home.ctaTitle: Let's Begin a Conversation of Value
home.ctaBody: Whether you're seeking strategy consulting, capital advisory, or content and brand services, our team is ready to talk.

about.title: Connecting Culture and Capital with Expertise and Vision
about.leadBody: Since its founding, Molnet Cultural Communication Limited has been committed to becoming a trusted bridge between the cultural industry and capital markets. We believe that outstanding cultural content, combined with rational capital, creates value that lasts.
about.storyTitle: Grounded in Expertise, Moving Toward Value
about.storyBody1: Molnet was founded by a group of professionals deeply rooted in the cultural industry, finance and international communication. We understand that a cultural project's success requires not only creativity, but clear strategy and solid capital support.
about.storyBody2: That is why we built an integrated platform combining strategy consulting, capital advisory and content production — helping clients find certainty and growth in a complex, fast-changing market.
about.value1Desc: Rigorous methodology and deep industry experience underpin every decision we make.
about.value2Desc: Rooted locally, thinking globally — every project is measured against international standards.
about.value3Desc: We reject short-term speculation, focusing instead on sustainable cultural assets and partnerships.
about.value4Desc: Built on trust, we share the long-term value of growth with every partner.
about.philosophyQuote: Where Culture Meets Capital, Intellect Meets Value.
about.philosophyQuoteZh: 文化与资本交汇，心智与价值共生。
about.philosophyBody: This is Molnet's core belief — we are both guardians of culture and creators of value. In every project, we strive to let the depth of culture and the power of capital elevate one another.
about.teamTitle: A Professional Team of Industry Veterans
about.teamBody: Our team members come from strategy consulting, investment banking, cultural media and international markets — united by one goal: delivering the most valuable service to our clients.

services.title: Professional Services Across the Cultural Value Chain
services.leadBody: From strategic planning and capital advisory to content delivery and global brand expansion, we offer full lifecycle services at the intersection of culture and capital.
services.service1Desc: Industry research, strategic planning and business model design for cultural enterprises, institutions and investors.
services.service2Desc: Connecting cultural projects with quality capital — full-cycle advisory from financing planning to deal execution.
services.service3Desc: Globally minded content production that helps brands and projects achieve cross-cultural reach.
services.service4Desc: From brand positioning to IP incubation and commercialization — building assets with lasting value.
services.process1Desc: Understanding your business context and core needs.
services.process2Desc: Crafting a tailored strategy and execution plan.
services.process3Desc: Assembling the right team to deliver efficiently.
services.ctaTitle: Find the Right Solution for You
services.ctaBody: Tell us about your project — our advisory team will respond within one business day.

contact.title: Let's Start a Conversation of Value
contact.leadBody: Whether it's strategy consulting, capital advisory, or content and brand collaboration, we'd love to hear from you.
